Usage: yantra doctor [options]

Diagnose the local environment for Yantra

Options:
  --provider <name>    agent model provider
  --model <id>         provider-scoped model id
  --thinking <level>   provider reasoning level
  --auth-secret <ref>  runtime model-key secret reference
  --no-llm             force the deterministic no-model path
  --json               emit JSON output (default: false)
  --refresh            re-probe the environment instead of reusing the cached
                       probe (agent and configuration checks always run fresh)
                       (default: false)
  --agent-smoke        run a live agent provider smoke test instead of the
                       offline checks (default: false)
  -h, --help           display help for command
